# A round item gets its own worktree from the engine, cut from its base branch, before the workflow file runs.
# The command steps and the agent step of the item run in that one folder: a git worktree, detached at the tip of the base, not at the project base.
isolate

exec git init -q -b main origin
exec git -C origin add readme.txt
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m start
exec git -C origin checkout -q -b integration/r1
exec git -C origin add BASE_MARKER
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m base
exec git -C origin checkout -q main
exec git -C origin rev-parse integration/r1
cp stdout base-tip

example local/project.star config/projects/local.star
replace config/projects/local.star '~/work/your-repo' $WORK/origin
# The script tests the round, not the sandbox, so its project keeps the sandbox off as it did before the example set it.
replace config/projects/local.star 'sandbox = "on"' 'sandbox = "off"'
subst flow/round.star
subst fake/claude
chmod 755 fake/claude

exec beehavereal item add local round/integration/r1 --title 'The round' --body-file body.txt
exec beehavereal run round/integration/r1 local --workflow flow/round.star
stdout 'item round/integration/r1 finished'

# One folder for every step, and it is a worktree of the clone, not an empty folder.
cmp before.pwd agent.pwd
cmp before.pwd after.pwd
cmp before.top agent.top
grep 'state/trees/local/round_2Fintegration_2Fr1$' before.top
grep '^base marker$' before.marker
grep '^base marker$' agent.marker
grep '^detached$' before.head
grep '^detached$' agent.head
grep -count=1 '^probe$' calls.log

# The tree is detached at the tip of the base. The release step removes a clean tree whose HEAD is a remote tip, so none is left.
exists state/trees/local
! exists state/trees/local/round_2Fintegration_2Fr1

-- body.txt --
The round of the base.
-- origin/readme.txt --
The source repository.
-- origin/BASE_MARKER --
base marker
-- flow/round.star --
def main(item):
    command(name = "before", run = ["sh", "-c", "pwd > @WORK@/before.pwd; git rev-parse --show-toplevel > @WORK@/before.top; cat BASE_MARKER > @WORK@/before.marker; git symbolic-ref -q HEAD > /dev/null && echo branch > @WORK@/before.head || echo detached > @WORK@/before.head"])
    agent(name = "probe", prompt = "prompts/probe.md", model = "m")
    command(name = "after", run = ["sh", "-c", "pwd > @WORK@/after.pwd"])
-- flow/prompts/probe.md --
Probe the folder.
-- fake/claude --
#!/bin/sh
cat > /dev/null
echo probe >> "@WORK@/calls.log"
pwd > "@WORK@/agent.pwd"
git rev-parse --show-toplevel > "@WORK@/agent.top"
cat BASE_MARKER > "@WORK@/agent.marker"
git symbolic-ref -q HEAD > /dev/null && echo branch > "@WORK@/agent.head" || echo detached > "@WORK@/agent.head"
echo '{"type":"result","session_id":"s1","result":"done"}'
